comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Seeing brief lock waits on notification_preferences when the preference UI writes concurrently — lowered batch size to 1_000.

content.text: Seeing brief lock waits on notification_preferences when the preference UI writes concurrently — lowered batch size to 1_000.

Workspaces created before 2025-01-01 never received rows in notification_preferences. Those accounts fall through to hard-coded defaults in the notification service, so product changes to default digests never reach them and support cannot toggle channels per workspace.

Backfill one preference row per (workspace_id, channel) for email, in_app, and slack with digest_frequency=weekly and quiet_hours_enabled=false. Run in batches of 2_500 workspaces with a 150ms pause to keep write IOPS under the RDS alert threshold. Idempotent on workspace_id+channel unique key.
